Simple Mahjong Rules 
###This rule doc generated by chatGPT 5.5 (Go version, modified by Maxwell Deng)###

This game is a Sichuan Mahjong simulator.

There are 4 players (in this version, 1 Human vs 3 Robots) in the game.
Each player tries to make a winning hand before the others.


----------------------------------------------------
Tiles

This version uses three suits:

- Wan / Characterss
- Tiao / Bamboo
- Bing / Dots

Each suit has tiles from 1 to 9.
There are 4 copies of each tile.


----------------------------------------------------
Goal

To win, a player needs a legal mahjong hand.
A normal winning hand has:

- 4 groups
- 1 pair

A group can be:

- a sequence, like 2-3-4 in the same suit
- a triplet, like three 5 Bing tiles

A pair is two same tiles.


----------------------------------------------------
Missing Suit

At the start of each round, every player chooses one missing suit.
The player should try to discard tiles from this suit.

A player cannot win if they still have tiles from their missing suit.


----------------------------------------------------
Basic Turn

On a normal turn, a player:

1. Draws one tile.
2. Chooses whether to keep it or discard it.
3. If they keep it, they discard one tile from their hand.


----------------------------------------------------
Triplet

If another player discards a tile, and you already have two same tiles,
you may take that tile and make a triplet.

After making a triplet, you must discard one tile.


----------------------------------------------------
Kong

A kong is four same tiles.

There are different kinds of kong:

- Concealed kong: you have four same tiles in your hand.
- Exposed kong: you make a kong with a tile from another player.
- Added kong: you already made a triplet, then later get the fourth tile.

After a kong, the player draws one extra tile, then continues the turn.


----------------------------------------------------
Mahjong

If a player has a legal winning hand, they can call Mahjong.
The round ends when a player wins, or when there are no tiles left in the wall.


----------------------------------------------------
Score

In this simple version:

- The winner gets 3 points.
- Each other player loses 1 point.
